meta.title: My Favorite Wok Spatula
meta.description:
You can order this spatula, as well as signed copy of my books from Earlywood, based out of Montana.

Order here: https://www.earlywooddesigns.com/collections/wood-cooking-utensils

This is not an advertisement, I do not get any money from these spatula, they're just a good tool made by good people I thought you might enjoy. Thanks!
